wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 11-005 wires the PCM mixer (DMX→int16 expansion, stereo separation, multi-voice mixing, int16 clipping) and the canonical Win32 audio output policy (16-bit, two double-buffer slices, 11025 Hz native SFX, 49716 Hz native music, 1024-sample SFX buffer, eight SFX channels) into a single frozen runtime artifact. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/pcmMixerWin32Output.ts imports expandDmxSamples/mixVoices/MIX_MAX_VOLUME/DEFAULT_OUTPUT_SAMPLE_RATE from src/audio/pcmMixer.ts and the canonical VANILLA_AUDIO_* constants from src/audio/implement-win32-audio-device-open-close.ts. The dlopen of winmm.dll and the per-buffer waveOutWrite FFI calls are intentionally NOT inlined — FFI calls cannot be unit-tested without a real audio device.
publicSurface: PcmMixerWin32Output interface (mix, expandDmxSamplesToOutputRate, mixerMaxVolume, mixerSfxBufferSampleCount, native/output sample rates, output channel/bit/buffer counts, shutdownPolicy, vanillaSfxChannelCount)
